title: Too Tidy for a Fox
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Something digs up Bess Hollin's pumpkin rows at night. Steward Edric Vane needs a culprit he can write down.

About

Given bySteward Edric Vane
Level41
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Pilfered Seed Pouch ×6

Steps

  1. Talk to Steward Edric Vane (outdoors around 1709, 1768) to get the quest.
  2. Ask Bess Hollin at 1795, 1872
  3. Glimmerfoxes (12)
    Pilfered seed pouches (6) - Pilfered Seed Pouch at 1795, 1875
  4. Report to Steward Vane at 1709, 1768

Rewards

Reward
Gold12,960
Character XP405,000
Quest points1

What Steward Edric Vane says

You: Steward Vane sent me about your pumpkin rows.

Bess Hollin: About time. Look at that row. Every seed dug out one at a time, and every hole filled in after.

Bess Hollin: A fox digs and runs. Whatever did this tidied up behind itself. I saw silver tails heading northeast before dawn.

Bess Hollin: That's my seed, all right. Now look at the pouches.

Bess Hollin: Every one tied with a knot I couldn't tie if you paid me. You go tell the Steward that.

Steward Edric Vane: Foxes that tie knots. I will write that down exactly as you said it.

Steward Edric Vane: The report goes to Captain Holt in the morning. I suspect she'll want a word with you.

Steward Edric Vane: Your fee, from the town purse. I have already signed for it.

Handing it in

"Your fee, from the town purse. I have already signed for it."
